Name: g_eFwStatMode
Comment: 0 = proxy via enable, 1 = inject real status

Name: g_eTrkMode
Comment: 0 = fallback: cut-off predicted world pose + MCS linear move (v1.x behavior, works without the tracking option and in simulation). 1 = native: MC_TrackConveyorBelt session + PCS synchronized moves (full-speed flying pick, firmware-managed belt following). Plain variable (not constant) so the mode can be switched from the HMI/init or per-line recipe without touching any POU.
